heading: The long version, kept short.
paragraphs: Eddy Lukovic is an actor and director based in San Diego. Raised between two languages and two cultures, he came to acting through a love of stories about people caught between worlds — immigrants, outsiders, quiet men with loud interior lives.
He trained in the Meisner technique and has worked across independent film, episodic television, and theatre.
When he isn't on set or in rehearsal, Eddy writes, boxes badly, and makes a very serious pot of coffee.
pullQuote: The best acting disappears — you don't watch it, you recognize it.
